availability: Use the authenticated tools/list response for actual availability and granted authority.

tools.description: Permanently delete exactly one owned image, animation or workflow run, only after the creator explicitly asked; confirmed must be true. Actions: delete_asset, delete_animation, delete_workflow. Set action and pass its arguments in the object named after it.

delete_animation.description: Delete the exact owned animation only after the creator explicitly requests deletion.

delete_asset.description: Delete the exact owned image only when the creator explicitly requested deletion. This affects the global library.

delete_workflow.description: Delete the exact owned workflow and its private history only when the creator explicitly requested deletion; normal library results survive.

tools.name: pixelbank_delete

tools.description: Change owned library items without processing or charges: prepare a web workspace, set tags, save a prepared cutout or recompose a saved GIF. Actions: prepare_workspace, update_asset_tags, save_cutout, recompose_animation, update_animation_tags. Set action and pass its arguments in the object named after it.

prepare_workspace.description: Prepare owned images, layer settings and a prompt for visual editing in Pixelbank. No image processing or workflow transition starts.

recompose_animation.description: Recompose the saved GIF from enabled frames for free. Supply the reviewed content revision.

save_cutout.description: Save an already prepared transparent cutout using a segmentation-cutout upload. This does not run SAM or consume credits.

update_animation_tags.description: Update tags on the selected owned animation.

update_asset_tags.description: Update tags on the explicitly selected owned image.

tools.name: pixelbank_edit

tools.description: Create a saved workflow, supply inputs or apply an allowed change at the acknowledged revision, or import an upload. No processing or charge. Actions: create_workflow, update_workflow, import_workflow_source. Set action and pass its arguments in the object named after it.

create_workflow.description: Create a saved workflow from a supported definition; this does not start processing.

import_workflow_source.description: Attach a workflow-input upload reference to the selected input step. Preserve the complete upload reference.

update_workflow.description: Supply an input or apply an allowed legacy change at the acknowledged revision. Running automatic inputs cannot change.

tools.name: pixelbank_edit_workflow

tools.description: Authorize and durably start the quoted workflow once. Preserve action_id, revision, quote_id and max_credits. One workflow charge includes up to three total attempts; tool free uses do not apply. The server completes all declared steps and saves library results; poll status without further writes.
tools.name: pixelbank_execute_workflow

tools.description: Start paid generation: an image, an animation or one animation frame correction. Actions: generate_image, generate_animation, correct_animation_frame. Set action and pass its arguments in the object named after it; operation_key, maximum_credits, paid_fallback_credits and workflow stay top-level. Retain the operation key and approved maximum across retries.

correct_animation_frame.description: Submit one frame correction using its reviewed content revision and instruction; poll the returned job.

generate_animation.description: Submit an animation using owned uploaded references and a motion prompt; poll the returned job identity.

generate_image.description: Generate from fully prepared images, roles, guides and masks. Prepare the Pixelbank web workspace when layers need visual composition.

tools.name: pixelbank_generate

tools.description: Read workflow progress without processing. Follow poll_after_seconds; stop when pollable is false.
tools.name: pixelbank_get_workflow_status

tools.description: Read an owned prepared workspace and its current web URL. Opening is handled by the installed bridge.
tools.name: pixelbank_get_workspace

tools.description: Issue a purpose-bound direct image upload. The local upload helper consumes this ticket without putting credentials in the conversation.
tools.name: pixelbank_issue_upload

tools.description: Start paid processing of one image: background removal, segmentation, segmentation with save or upscaling. Actions: remove_background, segment, segment_and_save, upscale_image. Set action and pass its arguments in the object named after it; operation_key, maximum_credits, paid_fallback_credits and workflow stay top-level. Retain the operation key and approved maximum across retries.

remove_background.description: Remove an image background and save the transparent result. Use the background-removal-input upload purpose. Retain the operation key and approved maximum credits.

segment.description: Run SAM rectangles in original image pixels (x, y, width, height); points must be empty. Use a segmentation-input upload. Use the prepared web workspace for interactive mask refinement.

segment_and_save.description: Run SAM rectangles in original image pixels (x, y, width, height) and save the cutout. Use a segmentation-input upload and an empty points list.

upscale_image.description: Submit an image enlargement with the exact confirmed quote and an approved credit maximum.

tools.name: pixelbank_process_image

tools.description: Read the connected account, owned images, animations, jobs and upscaling quotes. Nothing is changed, charged or counted. Actions: get_account, list_assets, get_asset, quote_upscaling, get_job, list_animations, get_animation, list_animation_jobs. Set action and pass its arguments in the object named after it. get_account takes no object: Read display information, credits and available free uses for the connected Pixelbank account. list_animation_jobs takes no object: Read active animation jobs, including frame corrections. Acceptance is not completion.

get_animation.description: Read an owned animation, current content revision, frames and download references.

get_asset.description: Read an owned image's dimensions, provenance, resized preview and original download reference.

get_job.description: Read an owned image-generation, animation or upscaling job and its actual result or failure.

list_animations.description: Browse owned saved animations with cursor pagination.

list_assets.description: Browse one owned image-library namespace with cursor pagination and an optional tag filter.

quote_upscaling.description: Read the current enlargement dimensions, credit amount and quote fingerprint without starting work.

tools.name: pixelbank_read

tools.description: Read supported workflow definitions, saved runs, their history and automatic-plan quotes. Starts no processing. Actions: list_workflow_definitions, list_workflows, get_workflow, get_workflow_activity, quote_workflow. Set action and pass its arguments in the object named after it. list_workflow_definitions takes no object: Discover supported workflow definitions and their required inputs before creating a run.

get_workflow.description: Read the saved workflow, source references and library results. Acceptance is not completion.

get_workflow_activity.description: Read the saved history of a supported owned workflow.

list_workflows.description: List supported saved workflows and definitions. Optional paging retains continuation metadata.

quote_workflow.description: Quote the finite automatic plan before authorization. This starts no processing.

tools.name: pixelbank_read_workflow

tools.description: Persist a verified workflow-input upload as an owned source for prepared web workspaces. No image-processing job starts.
tools.name: pixelbank_save_source
